root_idea.summary: The root denotes failure to attain or reach something because it has passed beyond one's grasp.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of non-attainment extends to something passing away from a person or opportunity. From the notion of separation arise meanings of distance, discrepancy, and incongruity; the derived notion of proceeding ahead without consultation reflects going before another in action.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quran-attested Form I verb.
Displayed as the Quran-attested noun فَوْتٌ.
Displayed as the Quran-attested verbal noun تَفَاوُتٌ.

senses.definition: To pass away from someone or elude them, becoming beyond their reach or attainment; to be missed or lost.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively with a thing, affair, opportunity, or other object that has passed beyond the person's ability to attain, perform, or recover it. Quranic occurrences use the construction فَاتَكُمْ.

senses.definition: Escape or elusion; the state of being beyond reach or attainment.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression فَلَا فَوْتَ, it denotes the impossibility of escaping apprehension. The noun can also describe something visible yet unattainable or beyond one's reach.

senses.definition: Incongruity, discrepancy, or defect; a lack of harmony or perfection.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of creation, it denotes the absence of any inconsistency, discordance, or imperfection that would call for correction or improvement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To precede or outstrip another; to get ahead of, or pass beyond, someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct use from the missed-opportunity sense, describing something that has got before another or taken precedence over it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die, especially to die suddenly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded as synonymous with فَادَ in this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a thing or affair to pass away from someone, be missed, or become beyond their reach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which the object is made unattainable or impossible for the person concerned to perform or recover.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act to another person's exclusion in disposing of property, including giving it away or squandering it without consultation or permission.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ in a property-management context; the construction expresses acting without the authority or participation of the person concerned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide separation or distinctness between things; difference or disparity, including disparity in excellence or eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to two things or persons that are far apart, different, or dissimilar in an assessed quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a poetic usage, the passing out or being spent of a period of life; being finished or run out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in an expression concerning the portion of life anterior to the Day of Resurrection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act, decide, or dispose of a matter without consulting the person whose order or authority should be sought; to proceed on one's own authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with عَلَى; it can describe deciding against or acting exclusively of another person in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To originate or extemporize speech; to speak without prior consideration, preparation, or hesitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with الكلام for speech produced spontaneously or without deliberation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom أَسْمَعُ صَوْتًا وَأَرَى فَوْتًا, hearing a sound while seeing no corresponding deed or action.
A gap or interval between things, especially the space between extended fingers; figuratively, a wide distance or disparity between persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative use may concern distance in rank, estimation, or standing. The plural is أَفْوَاتٌ.
Used in expressions such as مَوْتُ الفَوَاتِ for a death that comes unexpectedly or suddenly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who follows only their own opinion without consulting anyone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to either a man or a woman.
